rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing Article 121-7 and Decree No. 1398, Decree No. 1410 states that the President of the Russian Federation had not authorised 'Руцкого А.В.' to exercise particular powers of the President and that the appropriation of those powers 'Руцким А.В.' is unlawful and invalid under Article 121-3; point 1 declares acts issued by him in the name of the President unlawful and not to be executed; point 3 puts the decree into force from signature. It is signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин, Москва, Кремль, 22 сентября 1993 года, № 1410'.
